accepted_answers.name: argparse (Python standard library)
accepted_answers.why: Dependency-free standard answer; enterprise default, handles 95% of CLI cases.

accepted_answers.name: Typer
accepted_answers.why: Accepted as the 2026 consensus for new greenfield CLIs: type-hint driven, minimal boilerplate, built on Click.

accepted_answers.name: Click
accepted_answers.why: Accepted for plugin-heavy tools and legacy integrations; mature, fastest cold start of the third-party options.

notes: Nuanced consensus: argparse = stdlib-only/enterprise default; Typer = recommended for new projects; Click = plugin systems. Manual sys.argv parsing is never the answer beyond trivial scripts.
problem: Parsing command-line arguments in Python by hand-reading sys.argv.
